mandatoryCriteria: Owner-only project creation: Only workspace owner can create projects in the workspace via POST /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/projects; non-owners receive 403 FORBIDDEN (or 404 for ungranted workspace)
Project isolation: Projects created in the same workspace maintain independent memberships, boards, and access controls
Sibling project privacy: Users without grant on a project receive 404 NOT_FOUND on GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId
Project listing scoping: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/projects lists all workspace projects for owner, but only granted projects for non-owner members
Input validation: Project name is required non-empty string; description is optional string; unknown fields rejected with 400 or 422
Idempotency support: Project creation requires and enforces Idempotency-Key with transactional receipt
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/projects, GET /api/v1/projects/:projectId, and GET /api/v1/workspaces/:workspaceId/projects endpoints, owner authorization checks, sibling privacy, and idempotency receipts on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Default board and column creation is handled under BRD-01.
